96:   @Override
97:   public int score(LeafCollector collector, Bits acceptDocs, int min, int maxDoc)
98:       throws IOException {
99:     if (min != 0) {
100:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("min must be 0, got " + min);
101:     }
102:     if (maxDoc != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
103:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxDoc must be Integer.MAX_VALUE");
104:     }
105:     if (drillDownCollector != null) {
106:       drillDownLeafCollector = drillDownCollector.getLeafCollector(context);
107:     } else {
108:       drillDownLeafCollector = null;
109:     }
110:     for (DocsAndCost dim : dims) {
111:       dim.sidewaysLeafCollector = dim.sidewaysCollector.getLeafCollector(context);
112:     }
113: 
114:     // some scorers, eg ReqExlScorer, can hit NPE if cost is called after nextDoc
115:     long baseQueryCost = baseIterator.cost();
116: 
117:     final int numDims = dims.length;
118: 
119:     // Sort drill-downs by most restrictive first so later scoring can treat
120:     // dims[0] / dims[1] as the cheapest approximations.
121:     if (numDims > 1) {
122:       Arrays.sort(dims, APPROXIMATION_COMPARATOR);
123:     }
124: 
125:     long drillDownCost = 0;
126:     for (int dim = 0; dim < numDims; dim++) {
127:       drillDownCost += dims[dim].approximation.cost();
128:     }
129: 
130:     long drillDownAdvancedCost = 0;
131:     if (numDims > 1) {
132:       drillDownAdvancedCost = dims[1].approximation.cost();
133:     }
134: 
135:     // Position all scorers to their first matching doc:
136:     baseIterator.nextDoc();
137:     for (DocsAndCost dim : dims) {
138:       dim.approximation.nextDoc();
139:     }
140: 
141:     boolean queryFirstScoring = scoreSubDocsAtOnce || baseQueryCost < drillDownCost / 10;
142:     if (queryFirstScoring == false
143:         && numDims > 1
144:         && drillDownAdvancedCost < baseQueryCost / 10) {
145:       doDrillDownAdvanceScoring(acceptDocs, collector, dims);
146:       return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
147:     }
148:     if (queryFirstScoring == false) {
149:       doUnionScoring(acceptDocs, collector, dims);
150:       return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
151:     }
152: 
153:     Scorable scorableView = baseScorer;
154:     Scorable scoringView;
155:     if (scorableView instanceof ScoreCachingWrappingScorer) {
156:       scoringView = scorableView;
157:     } else {
158:       scoringView = ScoreCachingWrappingScorer.wrap(scorableView);
159:     }
160:     setScorer(collector, scoringView);
161: 
162:     if (dims.length == 1) {
163:       doQueryFirstScoringSingleDim(acceptDocs, collector, dims[0]);
164:       return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
165:     }
166: 
167:     List<DocsAndCost> sidewaysDims = new ArrayList<>(dims.length);
168:     sidewaysDims.addAll(List.of(dims));
169:     if (sidewaysDims.size() > 1) {
170:       CollectionUtil.timSort(sidewaysDims, APPROXIMATION_COMPARATOR);
171:     }
172: 
173:     List<DocsAndCost> sidewaysTwoPhaseDims = null;
174:     for (DocsAndCost dim : dims) {
175:       if (dim.twoPhase != null) {
176:         if (sidewaysTwoPhaseDims == null) {
177:           sidewaysTwoPhaseDims = new ArrayList<>();
178:         }
179:         sidewaysTwoPhaseDims.add(dim);
180:       }
181:     }
182:     if (sidewaysTwoPhaseDims != null) {
183:       CollectionUtil.timSort(sidewaysTwoPhaseDims, TWO_PHASE_COMPARATOR);
184:     }
185: 
186:     PriorityQueue<DocsAndCost> runawayDim =
187:         new PriorityQueue<>(1) {
188:           @Override
189:           protected boolean lessThan(DocsAndCost a, DocsAndCost b) {
190:             return a.approximation.docID() < b.approximation.docID();
191:           }
192:         };
193: 
194:     int docID = baseApproximation.docID();
195: 
196:     nextDoc:
197:     while (docID != DocIdSetIterator.NO_MORE_DOCS) {
198:       assert docID == baseApproximation.docID();
199: 
200:       if (acceptDocs != null && acceptDocs.get(docID) == false) {
201:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
202:         continue;
203:       }
204: 
205:       DocsAndCost runaway = runawayDim.top();
206:       if (runaway != null && runaway.approximation.docID() <= docID) {
207:         runawayDim.clear();
208:         runaway = null;
209:       }
210: 
211:       for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysDims) {
212:         int dimDocID;
213:         if (dim.approximation.docID() < docID) {
214:           dimDocID = dim.approximation.advance(docID);
215:         } else {
216:           dimDocID = dim.approximation.docID();
217:         }
218:         if (dimDocID != docID && dim != runaway) {
219:           DocsAndCost evicted = runawayDim.insertWithOverflow(dim);
220:           if (evicted != null) {
221:             int next = evicted.approximation.docID();
222:             docID = baseApproximation.advance(next);
223:             continue nextDoc;
224:           }
225:         }
226:       }
227: 
228:       if (baseTwoPhase != null && baseTwoPhase.matches() == false) {
229:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
230:         continue;
231:       }
232: 
233:       DocsAndCost failedDim = runawayDim.top();
234:       if (sidewaysTwoPhaseDims != null) {
235:         for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysTwoPhaseDims) {
236:           if (failedDim != dim) {
237:             assert dim.approximation.docID() == docID;
238:             if (dim.twoPhase.matches() == false) {
239:               if (failedDim != null) {
240:                 docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
241:                 continue nextDoc;
242:               }
243:               failedDim = dim;
244:             }
245:           }
246:         }
247:       }
248: 
249:       collectDocID = docID;
250:       if (failedDim == null) {
251:         collectHit(collector, sidewaysDims);
252:       } else {
253:         collectNearMiss(failedDim.sidewaysLeafCollector);
254:       }
255: 
256:       docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
257:     }
258: 
259:     return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
260:   }

262:   /**
263:    * Query-first scoring specialization when there is only one drill-sideways dimension, which is
264:    * likely a common scenario.

266:   private void doQueryFirstScoringSingleDim(
267:       Bits acceptDocs, LeafCollector collector, DocsAndCost dim) throws IOException {
268:     int docID = baseApproximation.docID();
269:     while (docID != DocIdSetIterator.NO_MORE_DOCS) {
270:       assert docID == baseApproximation.docID();
271: 
272:       if (acceptDocs != null && acceptDocs.get(docID) == false) {
273:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
274:         continue;
275:       }
276: 
277:       if (baseTwoPhase != null && baseTwoPhase.matches() == false) {
278:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
279:         continue;
280:       }
281: 
282:       // We have either a near-miss or full match. Check the sideways dim to see which it is:
283:       collectDocID = docID;
284:       if (advanceIfBehind(docID, dim.approximation) != docID
285:           || (dim.twoPhase != null && dim.twoPhase.matches() == false)) {
286:         // The sideways dim missed, so we have a "near miss":
287:         collectNearMiss(dim.sidewaysLeafCollector);
288:       } else {
289:         // Hit passed all filters, so it's "real":
290:         collectHit(collector, dim);
291:       }
292: 
293:       docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
294:     }
295:   }

297:   private static int advanceIfBehind(int docID, DocIdSetIterator iterator) throws IOException {
298:     if (iterator.docID() < docID) {
299:       return iterator.advance(docID);
300:     } else {
301:       return iterator.docID();
302:     }
303:   }

310:     final int maxDoc = context.reader().maxDoc();

351:             // }

353:             missingDims[slot] = 1;
354:             counts[slot] = 1;
355:           }
356:         }
357: 
358:         docID = dc.approximation.nextDoc();
359:       }

361:       // Second dim:
362:       // if (DEBUG) {
363:       //  System.out.println("  dim1");
364:       // }
365:       dc = dims[1];

370:           int slot = docID & MASK;

372:           if (docIDs[slot] != docID) {

378:             // }

396:               // " id=" + context.reader().document(docID).get("id"));
397:               // }

402:         docID = dc.approximation.nextDoc();

405:       // After this we can "upgrade" to conjunction, because
406:       // any doc not seen by either dim 0 or dim 1 cannot be
407:       // a hit or a near miss:
408: 
409:       // if (DEBUG) {
410:       //  System.out.println("  baseScorer");
411:       // }
412: 
413:       // Fold in baseScorer, using advance:
414:       int filledCount = 0;
415:       int slot0 = 0;
416:       while (slot0 < CHUNK && (slot0 = seen.nextSetBit(slot0)) != DocIdSetIterator.NO_MORE_DOCS) {
417:         int ddDocID = docIDs[slot0];

435:           // context.reader().document(ddDocID).get("id"));

472:               //  System.out.println("    set docID=" + docID + " count=" + (dim+2));
473:               // }
474:               missingDims[slot] = dim + 1;
475:               counts[slot] = dim + 2;
476:             } else {
477:               // if (DEBUG) {
478:               //  System.out.println("    set docID=" + docID + " missing count=" + (dim+1));
479:               // }
480:               counts[slot] = dim + 1;
481:             }
482:           }
483: 
484:           // TODO: sometimes use advance?
485:           docID = dc.approximation.nextDoc();
486:         }
487:       }
488: 
489:       // Collect:
490:       // if (DEBUG) {
491:       //  System.out.println("  now collect: " + filledCount + " hits");
492:       // }
493:       for (int i = 0; i < filledCount; i++) {
494:         int slot = filledSlots[i];
495:         collectDocID = docIDs[slot];
496:         collectScore = scores[slot];
497:         // if (DEBUG) {
498:         //  System.out.println("    docID=" + docIDs[slot] + " count=" + counts[slot]);

504:         }
505:       }
506: 
507:       if (nextChunkStart >= maxDoc) {
508:         break;
509:       }
510: 
511:       nextChunkStart += CHUNK;
512:     }
513:   }
